purpose: Prove the open Agent-neutral demand-driven human-Agent collaboration quality harness through goal-level natural-task dogfooding, dynamic capability discovery and lifecycle arbitration, an accepted methodology and open quality-conformance profile, and thin cross-host reference adapters that reuse sufficient external protocol, runtime, identity, audit, provenance, and evaluation layers.

increments.observedProblem: The current O1 and O2 collaboration-loss taxonomy rejects user-required context or handoff recovery when such an event is observed, and O4 measures context cost, but the O2/O4 cohort can still consist entirely of short tasks that never cross a host context-lifecycle boundary; v0.2 could therefore be accepted without exercising the constitution's task continuity obligation or the user's reported long-thread failure.
increments.hypothesis: Requiring the O2/O4 Codex reference cohort to include at least one accepted receipt whose context boundary and continuity floor are pre-registered and which actually crosses a native compaction, resume, clear, or host-required task rollover will close the false-positive path while keeping host mechanics in the reference profile, preserving the existing completion expression, and returning no context or handoff operation to the user.
increments.falsifier: Existing O2/O4 semantics already make a real context transition unavoidable, the added rule requires a user to choose or operate the boundary, makes a Codex event part of the Agent-neutral portable core, adds a new product outcome or human authority, cannot be enforced by the current code-owned semantic identity, or materially narrows unrelated eligible tasks instead of requiring one bounded cohort case.
increments.stopCondition: Stop after one bounded current-authority repair either proves the existing contract already excludes all-short-task acceptance or minimally requires one pre-registered Codex reference-host context-lifecycle crossing with zero user context or handoff recovery; synchronize the acceptance semantic identity, targeted regression tests, and directly affected public quality-profile text, record zero O1-O5 progress, restore an empty ready graph, and leave no temporary residue.

deliverables: one minimal acceptance-authority repair that prevents an all-short-task Codex cohort from satisfying v0.2 continuity claims without changing the release completion expression
